BUSINESS BEFORE ALL U. S. COURTS AT WASHINGTON ALL COURTS OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA AND MARYLAND. U. S. DEPARTMENTS.

REFERS, BY PERMISSION TO THE NATIONAL BANK OF WASHINGTON CABLE ADDRESS: "DLACY"

LAW OFFICES WILLIAM H. DELACY Ack. 5/27/ 14 SECOND FO. 65 FSTREET N. BUILDING No. 635 F STREET N.W. TELEPHONE, MAIN No. 8660 WASHINGTON. D. C. May 22, 1914.

Dear Col. Roosevelt:- Welcome home! and every good

luck attend you.

Sincerely yours,
